mn147:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn147:1.3: Atha kho Bhagavato rahogatassa patissallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
mn147:1.4: Paripakkā kho Rāhulassa vimutti paripācaniyā dhammā;
mn147:1.5: yannūnāhaṃ Rāhulaṃ uttariṃ āsavānaṃ khaye vineyyan ti.
mn147:1.6: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya Sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn147:1.7: Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ Rāhulaṃ āmantesi:
mn147:1.10: Evaṃ bhante ti kho āyasmā Rāhulo Bhagavato paṭissutvā nisīdanaṃ ādāya Bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhi.
mn147:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena anekāni devatāsahassāni Bhagavantaṃ anubandhāni honti:
mn147:2.2: Ajja Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Rāhulaṃ uttariṃ āsavānaṃ khaye vinessatīti.
mn147:2.3: Atha kho Bhagavā Andhavanaṃ ajjhogahetvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle paññatte āsane nisīdi.
mn147:2.4: Āyasmā pi kho Rāhulo Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn147:2.5: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Rāhulaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:
mn147:2.7: Cakkhuṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti?
mn147:2.9: Yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti?
mn147:2.11: Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallan nu taṃ samanupassituṃ:
mn147:2.12: Etaṃ mama, eso 'ham asmi, eso me attā ti?
mn147:3.2: Rūpā niccā vā aniccā vā ti?
mn147:3.4: Yaṃ panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti?
mn147:3.6: Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallan nu taṃ samanupassituṃ:
mn147:3.7: Etaṃ mama, eso 'ham asmi, eso me attā ti?
mn147:3.10: Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti?
mn147:3.12: Yam panāniccaṃ, dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti?
mn147:3.14: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ . . . attā ti? No h'
mn147:3.18: Cakkhusamphasso nicco vā anicco vā ti? --
mn147:3.26: Yaṃ idaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṃkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, tam pi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti?
mn147:4-8.1: Taṃ kim maññasi, Rāhula? Sotaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ va ti? --
mn147:4-8.3: Ghānaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti?
mn147:4-8.5: Jivhā niccā vā aniccā vā ti?
mn147:4-8.7: Kāyo nicco vā anicco vā ti?
mn147:4-8.9: Mano nicco vā anicco vā ti? --
mn147:4-8.16: Taṃ kim maññasi, Rāhula? Dhammā niccā vā aniccā vā ti? --
mn147:4-8.23: Taṃ kim maññasi, Rāhula? Manoviññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti? --
mn147:4-8.30: Taṃ kim maññasi, Rāhula? Manosamphasso nicco vā anicco vā ti? --
mn147:4-8.38: Yam p' idaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṃkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, tam pi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti?
mn147:9.1: Evaṃ passaṃ, Rāhula, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃ nibbindati rūpesu nibbindati cakkhuviññāṇe nibbindati cakkhusamphasse nibbindati; yam p' idaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṃkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, tasmim pi nibbindati.
mn147:9.6: manasmiṃ nibbindati, dhammesu nibbindati, manoviññāṇe nibbindati, manosamphasse nibbindati. Yam p' idaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṃkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, tasmiṃ pi nibbindati,
mn147:9.7: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam iti ñāṇaṃ hoti:
mn147:9.8: Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
mn147:9.11: Imasmiṃ kho pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne, āyasmato Rāhulassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucci.
mn147:9.12: Tāsañ c' anekānaṃ devatāsahassānaṃ virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi:
mn147:9.13: Yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ, sabban taṃ nirodhadhamman ti. 148.
